basis: Neurodevelopmental impairment and skeletal overgrowth define Sotos syndrome; cardiac, renal and hearing abnormalities are not consistently present in at least 30%.
Thrombosis occupies the portal vein; hepatic parenchymal damage is not inherent.
External ear and mandibular condyle malformations, with defining oral anomalies; hearing loss and developmental impairment occur in fewer than 30%.
A dermal atrophy disorder according to its ancestry; macular describes skin lesions here.
Intellectual disability, spastic paraplegia and severe CNS malformations define the syndrome; short stature alone does not establish skeletal damage.
Pigment deficiency specifically affects the eyelid, which belongs to the ocular axis.
Malignancy of the colon or rectum; other hereditary cancers and metastatic sites are not consistent organ involvement across this umbrella.
Primary immunodeficiency; bronchiectasis affects 30-79%. Hepatosplenomegaly and intestinal lymphoid hyperplasia alone do not establish functional damage; hearing loss is under 30%.
Platelet dysfunction, cutaneous albinism and neutropenic immunodeficiency define HPS2; visual impairment is characteristic (2/2). Other reported organ involvement omitted at cap.
Limb bone malformations and microcephaly/intellectual disability define the syndrome; nail hypoplasia affects 80-99%, with absent nails in 30-79%.
Achalasia, microcephaly and intellectual disability are defining features; abnormal dermatoglyphics do not establish skin damage.
Allergic immune-mediated dermatitis caused by ingested food; ingestion does not imply gastrointestinal damage.
Prostatic origin is outside the axes, but this explicitly metastatic disease commonly occupies bone (~80-90%); skeletal tumor involvement supplies the applicable primary axis.
Carcinoma arises in the thyroid gland, an endocrine organ.
Atherosclerotic lesions directly affect the coronary arteries; associated lipid disorders are separate diseases.
Benign neoplasm arising from skeletal muscle tissue.
Developmental impairment and chronic immune activation; skeletal deformities/enchondromatosis and hyperkeratosis reported in 1/1. Separately diagnosed cancers do not label predisposition.
GPI-anchor glycosylation disorder with seizures/developmental impairment; strabismus and digital/foot malformations occur in 30-79%. Hypotonia does not establish primary muscle disease.
Bacterial infection umbrella spanning multiple sites; no single additional organ is consistently affected across the group.
GPI-anchor disorder with ID; distal phalanx shortening 2/2 and bowel stenosis/aganglionosis 1/2. Ocular 2/3, cardiac/hearing 1/2 omitted at cap; cohorts are small.
Immune-mediated ulcerative colitis confined to the left colon.
Gingival inflammation, usually driven by bacterial dental plaque; gums belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Hereditary coagulation factor defect associated with abnormal clotting and bleeding.
Extranodal B-cell lymphoma; gastric/GI occupation occurs in roughly 40-50%. Pulmonary involvement is under 30% across the umbrella despite the supplied high-frequency infiltrate annotation.
Inherited basal epidermal fragility causes skin blistering; oral mucosal blistering directly damages the mouth in 30-79%.
